   443	def iter_probes(manifest, segments):
   444	    """Yield the scheduled probes in canonical order.
   445	
   446	    Each item is a tuple:
   447	        (probe_id, window, scope, subnet, target_int, role, slot, attempt,
   448	         sent_ms, deadline_ms, segment_index)
   449	    """
   450	    attempts = manifest["attempts"]
   451	    spacing_ms = manifest["spacing_ms"]
   452	    timeout_ms = manifest["timeout_ms"]
   453	    ordinals = {}
   454	    for index, segment in enumerate(segments):
   455	        ordinal = ordinals.get(segment.window, 0)
   456	        sent_base = segment.start_ms + ordinal * spacing_ms
   457	        for role, slot, iid in segment.targets:
   458	            target = segment.base | iid
   459	            for attempt in range(attempts):
   460	                sent_ms = sent_base
   461	                deadline_ms = sent_ms + timeout_ms
   462	                yield (
   463	                    "%s/%s/%d/%s-%d/%d"
   464	                    % (segment.window, segment.scope, segment.subnet, role, slot, attempt),
   465	                    segment.window,
   466	                    segment.scope,
   467	                    segment.subnet,
   468	                    target,
   469	                    role,
   470	                    slot,
   471	                    attempt,
   472	                    sent_ms,
   473	                    deadline_ms,
   474	                    index,
   475	                )
   476	                sent_base += spacing_ms
   477	                ordinal += 1
   478	        ordinals[segment.window] = ordinal
